title: Claude Code plugin manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json)
description: Manifest of a Claude Code plugin. The manifest is optional; when present, name is the only required field. Built from the official Claude Code docs (Plugins reference), cross-checked against the changelog and the claude CLI 2.1.281.
$comment: POLICY: stricter than Claude Code. Every object closes its keys (additionalProperties or unevaluatedProperties false), because this repository authors these files and a typo the CLI silently ignores is a bug. x-cli-unknown-keys records, measured on 2.1.310, what the CLI does with an unknown key in that object: rejects (error, the component fails to load), warns (warning; claude plugin validate --strict fails) or ignores (no message). Fields the CLI accepts but the docs do not name carry x-docs-status (cli-tolerated, cli-only, changelog-only). SCOPE: strict-mode contract. additionalProperties is false because 'claude plugin validate --strict' turns the runtime's unknown-field warning into a failure (docs: 'Pass --strict to treat warnings as errors'). At runtime Claude Code ignores unrecognized top-level fields, so a manifest that fails only on additionalProperties still loads; drop 'additionalProperties: false' at the root for a lenient editor experience. Properties carrying x-docs-status other than absent are NOT in the official docs' manifest reference: documented-once = mentioned in one other docs page; changelog-only = named only in the changelog; cli-tolerated / cli-only = accepted by the claude 2.1.281 binary but undocumented. Remove them for a docs-only schema. Not expressible in draft-07 and left to claude plugin validate: path existence, hooks/MCP inline shapes (placeholders here), name uniqueness of monitors, options-default membership, channels[].server matching an mcpServers key. Inline hooks and MCP shapes are placeholders owned by other schemas; the LSP definitions are generated from the same source as lsp.schema.json.

userConfigOption.description: One user-configurable value. Claude Code prompts for it when the plugin is enabled and exposes it as ${user_config.KEY} and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>. Unknown keys are rejected.

type.description: Value type: string, number, boolean, directory or file.

title.description: Label shown in the configuration dialog.

description.description: Help text shown beneath the field.

sensitive.description: If true, input is masked and the value is stored in secure storage (macOS Keychain or ~/.claude/.credentials.json) instead of settings.json. Cannot be combined with options.

required.description: If true, validation fails when the field is empty.

default.description: Value used when the user provides nothing. With options it must be one of the options (the schema cannot cross-check that).

items.description: One accepted value, 1-64 characters, no leading/trailing space, no control/invisible/bidi characters.

options.description: For type string: the only values the field accepts, shown in /config as a picker. Requires Claude Code v2.1.271 or later (older versions cannot load a plugin that declares options). Rules: type must be string; multiple and sensitive must not be true; default must be one of the options, or required must be true when default is unset; options must not repeat even in a different letter case.

multiple.description: For type string: allow an array of strings. Cannot be combined with options.

type.description: A field with options must have type string.

multiple.description: A field with options must not set multiple to true.

sensitive.description: A field with options must not set sensitive to true.

required.description: Without a default, a field with options must set required to true.

userConfigMap.description: Map of option key to user-configurable value definition (see userConfigOption).

propertyNames.description: Option key: a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; no leading digit). It becomes CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> in hook processes.

monitor.description: One background monitor. Unknown keys are rejected.

name.description: Identifier unique within the plugin (uniqueness cannot be expressed in this schema; duplicates are an error). Prevents duplicate processes on reload or repeated skill invocation.

command.description: Shell command run as a persistent background process in the session working directory; every stdout line is delivered to Claude as a notification. Supports ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} and ${ENV_VAR}; ${user_config.*} is rejected.

description.description: Short summary of what is watched; shown in the task panel and notification summaries.

when.description: When the monitor starts: 'always' (default) at session start and on plugin reload, or 'on-skill-invoke:<skill-name>' the first time the named skill in this plugin is dispatched.

channel.description: One message channel bound to an MCP server the plugin provides. Unknown keys are rejected.

server.description: Name of the MCP server this channel binds to. Must match a key in the plugin's mcpServers (not checked by claude plugin validate).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the config dialog title (for example Telegram). Defaults to the server name.
displayName.x-source: CLI 2.1.281 runtime schema and CLI-generated channel scaffold; not on the docs Channels section

userConfig.description: Fields to prompt for when the plugin is enabled; same schema as the top-level userConfig. Values are referenced as ${user_config.KEY} in the bound server's configuration.

manifest.title: Manifest fields
manifest.description: Every plugin.json field a marketplace entry also accepts (all but the directory listing fields). Open on purpose: plugin.json and marketplace entries close it with unevaluatedProperties.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete and validation. Claude Code ignores it at load time.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier in kebab-case (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), no spaces, control characters or bidirectional-formatting characters. Used to namespace components (for example plugin-dev:agent-creator). When a marketplace entry lists the plugin under a different name, the entry name is what enabledPlugins and /plugin use. Non-kebab names load at runtime but claude plugin validate warns (the claude.ai marketplace sync requires kebab-case).
name.x-policy: Repository policy, stricter than Claude Code: kebab-case is required here, while Claude Code loads other names and claude plugin validate only warns (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/publish#prepare-your-plugin-for-release).

not.description: Reserved: starts with claude-, anthropic-, anthropics- or cc-plugin-; is claude, anthropic, anthropics, claude-code or claude-mods; or puts official beside claude or anthropic.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the /plugin picker and other UI. A displayName on the marketplace entry takes precedence. May contain spaces and any casing; not used for namespacing or lookup.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Setting it pins the plugin: users only receive updates when you bump it. If also set in the marketplace entry, plugin.json wins. If omitted, the version comes from the marketplace entry, the git commit SHA, an archive digest, or 'unknown' (see Version management). The docs call it 'A version string, not checked against semver'; the pattern is this repository's policy (x-policy).
version.x-policy: Repository policy, stricter than Claude Code: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH is required here, while the docs call the field 'A version string, not checked against semver' (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#version).

description.description: Brief explanation of the plugin's purpose.

author.description: Author information. name is required; extra keys are tolerated by Claude Code.

name.description: Display name of the plugin author or organization.

url.description: Website, GitHub profile or organization URL.

homepage.description: Documentation or homepage URL. Must be a valid absolute URL (enforced by the CLI).

repository.description: Source code URL (a plain string; not an npm-style object).

license.description: SPDX license identifier, for example MIT or Apache-2.0. Not validated by the CLI.

keywords.description: Discovery tags. A non-array value is a load error.

metadata.description: Free-form object for your own data (entitlement, catalog fields). Claude Code does not read it; a non-object value is ignored with a validate warning.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the plugin starts enabled when the user has no explicit setting. Defaults to true. The user's enabledPlugins entry and a dependency requirement take precedence; a marketplace-entry value overrides this one.

skills.description: Custom skill directories containing <name>/SKILL.md, or '.'/'./' for the plugin root when it holds a SKILL.md itself. Adds to the default skills/ scan (except for a marketplace entry whose source is the marketplace root). A file path is an error.

anyOf.description: Skill directory relative to the plugin root (./...) or '.' for the plugin root itself.

items.description: Skill directory relative to the plugin root (./...) or '.'.

commands.description: Custom flat .md skill files or directories (replaces the default commands/ directory; list ./commands/ explicitly to keep it). The object form (command name -> definition) is accepted by the CLI but not documented.

anyOf.description: Command file or directory relative to the plugin root.

items.description: Command file or directory relative to the plugin root.

anyOf.description: Object form (undocumented; CLI 2.1.281 and SchemaStore baseline): command name -> definition with exactly one of source or content.

source.description: Path to the command markdown file, relative to the plugin root.

content.description: Inline markdown content for the command.

argumentHint.description: Hint for command arguments, for example [file].

allowedTools.description: Tools allowed when the command runs.

agents.description: Custom agent files (replaces the default agents/ directory). Each entry must be a .md file, not a directory; files listed here load without subfolder names in their scoped name.

anyOf.description: Agent markdown file relative to the plugin root, starting with ./ and ending in .md.

items.description: Agent markdown file relative to the plugin root, starting with ./ and ending in .md.

workflows.description: Custom workflow script files (.js) or directories (replaces the default workflows/ directory).

anyOf.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

items.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

hooks.description: Hook configuration: a path to a hooks JSON file (./..., .json), an inline hooks object, or an array mixing both. Adds to hooks/hooks.json. Inline object shape is owned by the hooks schema (placeholder here).

anyOf.description: Path to a hooks JSON file relative to the plugin root. The file uses the wrapped format {"hooks": {...}}.
Path to a hooks JSON file.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configuration: a path to a .json file, an inline server map, or an array mixing paths and maps. Adds to .mcp.json. The server-config shape is owned by the MCP schema (placeholder here). The .mcpb/.dxt bundle forms are CLI-accepted but not in the docs.

anyOf.description: Path to an MCP config JSON file relative to the plugin root.
Path (./...) or URL of an MCPB/DXT bundle ending in .mcpb or .dxt (undocumented; CLI 2.1.281 and SchemaStore baseline).
Path to an MCP config JSON file.
Path or URL of an MCPB/DXT bundle (undocumented).

outputStyles.description: Custom output style files or directories (replaces the default output-styles/ directory).

anyOf.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

items.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

lspServers.description: Language-server configuration: a path to a .lsp.json-format file, an inline server map, or an array mixing both. Wherever it comes from, a plugin's servers are merged (the default ./.lsp.json is also read).

anyOf.description: Path, relative to the plugin root and starting with ./, of a JSON file in .lsp.json format.
Path, relative to the plugin root and starting with ./, of a JSON file in .lsp.json format.

experimental.description: Experimental components whose manifest schema may change between releases. Declare themes, monitors and evals here. Unknown keys inside produce a validate warning; a non-object value is ignored with a warning.

themes.description: Color theme files or directories, relative to the plugin root (replaces the default themes/ directory).

anyOf.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

items.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

monitors.description: Background monitors: a path (relative, starting with ./, ending in .json) to a JSON file containing the monitors array, or the monitors array inline.

anyOf.description: Path to a JSON file holding the monitors array.
Inline monitor entries.

evals.description: Directory below the plugin root that holds the plugin's eval cases when it is not the default evals/. A list is accepted; its first entry is the case directory. Must be a relative path of plain directory names (no absolute path, no ..). claude plugin eval --eval-dir overrides it.

anyOf.description: Relative eval directory, for example quality/evals.

outputStyles.description: Output styles declared under experimental (undocumented alternative to the top-level outputStyles).

anyOf.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

items.description: Path relative to the plugin root, starting with ./.

remote.description: Where to fetch the language: npm:<pkg>[@ver] or github:<owner>/<repo>@<ref>#<path>.js.

integrity.description: Integrity hash (sha256-, sha384- or sha512- base64).

userConfig.description: User-configurable values prompted when the plugin is enabled. Keys must be identifiers. Values are available as ${user_config.KEY} in MCP/LSP configs and hook commands (not in shell-form hook commands, monitor commands or MCP headersHelper), as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> in hook processes, and (non-sensitive only) in skill/agent content. Non-sensitive values are stored under pluginConfigs in user settings; sensitive ones in secure storage.

propertyNames.description: Option key: a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; no leading digit). It becomes CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> in hook processes.

channels.description: Channel declarations for message injection (Telegram, Slack, Discord style). Each entry binds to an MCP server the plugin provides.

anyOf.description: Bare plugin name (tracks the latest available version). The CLI also accepts name@marketplace and a legacy trailing @^range; the docs only document the bare name.
A dependency with optional version constraint and marketplace. Extra keys are tolerated by Claude Code.

name.description: Plugin name. Resolves within the same marketplace as the declaring plugin unless marketplace is set.

version.description: A semver range such as ~2.1.0, ^2.0, >=1.4 or =2.1.0. The dependency is fetched at the highest tagged version satisfying it. Pre-release versions are excluded unless the range opts in (for example ^2.0.0-0).

marketplace.description: A different marketplace to resolve name in. Blocked unless the target marketplace is listed in allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn in the root marketplace's marketplace.json.

dependencies.description: Other plugins this plugin requires, optionally with semver constraints. A manifest may consist of only name and dependencies to bundle a curated plugin set behind one install.

settings.description: Default settings applied while the plugin is enabled. Only the agent and subagentStatusLine keys are supported; unknown keys are silently ignored. A settings.json at the plugin root takes priority over this field. Mentioned only in the 'Ship default settings' section of the Plugins guide, not in the manifest reference.

agent.description: Name of one of the plugin's agents to activate as the main thread (applies its system prompt, tool restrictions and model).

subagentStatusLine.description: Custom row body for subagents in the agent panel; same shape as the subagentStatusLine setting (see Statusline docs).

settings.x-cli-unknown-keys: ignores (keys other than agent and subagentStatusLine are dropped at load)

types.description: Path to the plugin's type contract, a self-contained .d.ts starting with ./ (used by /plugin-types and validated by claude plugin validate). Undocumented; CLI 2.1.281 only.

binaries.description: sha256-pinned files fetched into bin/ at install time, keyed by basename (target triple encoded in the name). At most 16 valid entries are fetched. Undocumented; CLI 2.1.281 only.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file.
